policy: the site is rebuilt only from artefacts that clear these gates; a failing gate is a reason to stop, and the remedy column says who to blame

gates.name: newest official injury report is filed for the game day priced
gates.detail: newest revision printed: 2026-11-16 01:15 PM ET; read 2026-11-16T18:30Z
gates.remedy_if_failing: wait for the next filing window; the league files by 5 p.m. local the day before, 1 p.m. for back-second games, and on game day between 11 a.m. and 1 p.m. ET

gates.name: two revisions of the same game day are stored, so a diff is possible
gates.remedy_if_failing: the diff is the point: one revision is a snapshot, two are a status change

gates.name: every transcript hashes to what the artefact records
gates.detail: 4 transcripts checked against the sha256 written into the artefacts
gates.remedy_if_failing: a mismatch means a committed transcript was edited after it was parsed: revert the transcript or rebuild the artefact, never both silently

gates.name: every published row names an https NBA source
gates.detail: injury rows point at the ak-static PDF, standings at nba.com/standings
gates.remedy_if_failing: a row without an NBA source must be dropped from the artefact, not relabelled

gates.name: the standings table and the results log describe the same games
gates.detail: 30/30 clubs reconcile; sum of games played 394 = 2 x 197
gates.remedy_if_failing: if a club stops reconciling, one of the two sources moved: re-read both before publishing a line

gates.name: no result is used before its official final is verified
gates.detail: 9/9 of the 2026-11-15 rows have a final printed by an official source; the one with a quarter conflict is excluded from quarter-level measures
gates.remedy_if_failing: a game with no verified final stays unsettled; a settlement stamp must name the source
